description: This file defines the ThreadLocalPythonObjects class, which manages thread-local Python objects in the PyTorch codebase. It provides static methods to set, get, and check the existence of objects associated with string keys, as well as to get and set the overall thread-local state.
external_methods: SafePyObject (constructor and methods, as defined in included header)

classes.name: ThreadLocalPythonObjects
classes.description: Provides thread-local storage and access to Python objects via static methods, managing an internal unordered map.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a thread-local Python object associated with a key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the Python object associated with a key.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the thread-local storage.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Returns the current thread-local state snapshot.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the thread-local state to the provided value.
